name: Erebos
description: Erebos is the god of the dead and ruler of the Underworld on Theros, a jealous god who wields a whip and is the long-time rival of Heliod.

bio.text: Erebos sent Athreos to take the oracle Daxos to the Underworld, and Daxos's mother Lidia took her son's place and was brought there instead.

citations.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In Kytheon's origin, Kytheon threw Heliod's spear at Erebos, who redirected it and killed all his irregulars, after which Kytheon planeswalked to Bant and became Gideon Jura.

citations.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Revised Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Silence of the Gods left Erebos unable to receive souls, and after Elspeth slew Xenagos the gods went to war while Erebos neglected the souls in his charge out of hatred of Heliod.

citations.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Erebos tested Elspeth with an illusion of family life, agreed to trade Daxos's soul for hers, and accepted her offer of her life.

citations.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lidia takes Daxos to Athreos; he speaks and is revealed to be an oracle; Erebos sends Athreos to claim him.
timeline.quote: Athreos was sent to claim the child

citation.text: "Daxos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Daxos is freed from the Underworld as one of the Returned, searching for Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Daxos was freed from the Underworld in a cruel bargain with Erebos

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Daxos the Returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to fetch Daxos for his oracular gift; Lidia takes her son's place and is brought to the Underworld.
timeline.quote: thus she was brought to the Underworld while Daxos was left alone in the Mortal Realm.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Erebos unable to receive souls, causing a buildup of eidolons and Returned.
timeline.quote: leaving him unable to receive souls into the Underworld

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Elspeth slays Xenagos, Heliod has Daxos remove traces of other gods from Meletis; the gods go to war, rifts open to the Underworld, and Erebos neglects the souls under his charge out of hatred of Heliod.
timeline.quote: He hated Heliod most of all, and in his rage, he neglected to keep a tight grip on the souls under his purview.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Elspeth defeats Heliod, Erebos places him beneath a boulder in the Underworld and gives Elspeth his gratitude and safe passage home.
timeline.quote: Erebos took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder in the Underworld

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos is compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Erebos was compleated.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod arms Kytheon and sends him after a Titan sent rampaging by Erebos, leading to his companions' deaths and his ascension as a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: It was Heliod who armed Kytheon (later known as Gideon ) and sent him after a Titan that Erebos had sent rampaging across Theros.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights Heliod at the borders of the Underworld and shatters his spear; Erebos chains Heliod beneath a boulder.
timeline.quote: chained Heliod into the Underworld beneath a giant boulder.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Originally a mortal trapped in the Underworld, Phenax hides from Erebos and Athreos by forsaking his identity and crosses back wrapped in Athreos's cloak, becoming the first Returned.
timeline.quote: This escape established his role as the first Returned and set him on the path to godhood.

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the land of the dead by using the Tartyx's waters to strip himself of identity.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to find a route of escape out of the land of the dead

citation.text: "Returned", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Tymaret to slaughter the escaped Returned, and Tymaret becomes monarch of Odunos.
timeline.quote: Tymaret, who was sent by Erebos to slaughter the escaped Returned

citation.text: "Returned", section "Odunos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The gods, born from mortal prayer, seal the titans away in the Underworld with Klothys as eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The sealing of the titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth offers her life for Daxos; Erebos accepts and Heliod fatally wounds his former champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth offered her life in trade for her lover Daxos .

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's Shadowspear is acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod's spear shatters, and Erebos imprisons Heliod in the Underworld forever.
timeline.quote: Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The other gods call their champions from the Underworld and war breaks out; rifts to the Underworld release monsters and Polukranos besieges Setessa.
timeline.quote: The giant nyxborn hydra Polukranos laid siege to Setessa , which was defended by Haktos .

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos places the defeated Heliod beneath a boulder and gives Elspeth safe passage back to the mortal realm.
timeline.quote: Erebos simply took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A great storm breaks; Solon sees the gods in the lightning and believes Erebos and Nylea oppose him while Thassa defends him.
timeline.quote: Erebos and Nylea contrive to end my journey here, while Thassa herself defends me.

citation.text: "The Sea God's Labyrinth, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Pavios prays to Erebos, who permits him to join Thanasis in death, and Pavios falls on the sword.
timeline.quote: the blade drove into Pavios's heart.

citation.text: "Emonberry Red" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Phenax promises the newly dead they will be spared from Erebos.
timeline.quote: Phenax promised the newly dead souls they would be spared from Erebos.

citation.text: Black Oak of Odunos (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alkmenos, who refused to bow to Erebos in death, is bowed for eternity.
timeline.quote: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.

citation.text: Weight of the Underworld (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to take Daxos to the Underworld; despite Karametra's efforts Athreos seizes the boy, and Lidia offers herself in his place and is taken instead.
timeline.quote: Lidia offered herself in her son's place and was taken to the Underworld instead.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth smashes the false-life goblet and passes Erebos's ordeal.
timeline.quote: Though it broke her heart, she smashed the cup and passed Erebos's ordeal.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The satyr tells of the Underworld's coinsmiths who mint ostraka from funerary masks, and explains that Erebos equalizes everyone and forbids a return except as one of the Returned.
timeline.quote: Erebos cares little for what you were in life. He only cares that you once existed.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Kytheon saves the Kolophon from harpies and cyclopes, defeats the titan of Erebos with Heliod's spear, then throws the spear at Erebos, who kills his irregulars; Kytheon first planeswalks to Bant and becomes Gideon Jura.
timeline.quote: Shocked and shamed by their deaths at his hand, Kytheon then made his first planeswalk to Bant, where he became known as Gideon Jura.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the revised origin, Kytheon throws Heliod's spear at Erebos, who redirects it and kills all his irregulars; ashamed, he makes his first planeswalk to Bant and becomes Gideon.
timeline.quote: Erebos easily changed the course of the spear, killing all the irregulars.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Revised Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, Liliana helps the Gatewatch; Gideon is trapped in an illusion with Erebos, freed by Jace, while Emrakul is sealed in the moon.
timeline.quote: Gideon was trapped in a scene where he was confronted again by Erebos

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace sees in a window Gideon, addressed as Kytheon Iora, questioned by the celestial Erebos, who threatens to kill his friends unless he says what he most desires.
timeline.quote: It is not an offer, mortal.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon recalls Heliod and the death of his Irregulars, doubting he can trust a god again.
timeline.quote: The mission Heliod had set before him had led to the death of Gideon's closest friends, his Irregulars.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Haunted by memories of lost friends, Gideon chooses to leave and live and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: He willed his body through the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: With Shadowspear acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod yields and Erebos imprisons him in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: The God of the Sun was forced to yield and Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Beyond death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As war breaks out among the gods, Erebos is consumed by hatred of Heliod and begins to lose control of his realm's souls.
timeline.quote: Erebos was consumed by his hatred of Heliod

citation.text: "Klothys", section "Return to the mortal world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the Underworld unnoticed by Athreos or Erebos.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to escape the Underworld without drawing the notice of Athreos or Erebos

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tymaret witnesses Phenax's escape and informs Erebos, who lets him leave the Underworld as a Returned to catch Phenax.
timeline.quote: The only witness to Phenax's escape was Tymaret

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pavios prays to Erebos, who promises they can be together in his realm; Pavios falls on his sword.
timeline.quote: And so, Pavios threw himself on his sword, and for a moment, he laughed.

citation.text: "Pavios and Thanasis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Penthikos prays for atonement and Erebos answers, freeing him to enter a cave.
timeline.quote: Erebos 's great voice filled the air, acknowledging his prayer

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the River of the Dead a scholar of Athreos refuses him passage until a death mask forms on his face.
timeline.quote: he felt the matter on his face shift and sculpt itself into a grimacing death mask

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: According to a rarely whispered tale, Phenax was destined to free the Titans, so mortals killed him and the gods later allowed his escape.
timeline.quote: the gods later allowed his escape to protect themselves

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Phenax's Secret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos drags Anikthea, a former council member, to the Underworld, where she becomes a demigod serving Setessa.
timeline.quote: Dragged to the Underworld by Erebos , she serves Setessa's interests as a demigod

citation.text: "Setessa", section "Notable Setessans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Heliod runs Elspeth through with Godsend and orders Ajani to carry her to Erebos.
timeline.quote: "Carry her back to the mortal realm, leonin. Deliver her to Erebos,"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Elspeth tells Ajani how she tricked Heliod into a second confrontation, letting Erebos imprison him.
timeline.quote: she gave Erebos, God of the Dead, an opportunity to imprison Heliod.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is mortally wounded in the brawl, seeing Erebos's cold approach, until Giada feeds her Halo that heals her.
timeline.quote: It smashed into her ribs as Elspeth had been straining to hoist her sword

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Erebos steals Anikthea away to Agonas.
timeline.quote: stole her away to Agonas, dragging her down through the mouth of Cirkis as she slept

citation.text: "Anikthea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos pits his champions against her, then offers her freedom if she fights to the surface.
timeline.quote: offered her a deal: fight her way to the surface and win her freedom

citation.text: "Anikthea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anikthea agrees to serve Erebos if she may protect her people, and becomes a demigod.
timeline.quote: she would serve Erebos as long as she could return home to protect her people when they needed her most

citation.text: "Anikthea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth defeats Heliod and is granted life by Erebos, then planeswalks away; Calix sparks and planeswalks after her.
timeline.quote: until he sparked and planeswalked after her for their destined confrontation

citation.text: "Calix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos tests Elspeth with an illusion of a family life; she smashes the golden cup and enters Nyx.
timeline.quote: By smashing the illusion’s golden cup, she proved her resolve and gained entry to the starry realm of the gods.

citation.text: "Deicide in Nyx", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth asks Erebos to trade her soul for Daxos's, and he agrees.
timeline.quote: Erebos agreed, pleased to claim the soul of a mortal who dared slay a god.

citation.text: "Deicide in Nyx", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maia brings asters to her father's ruined smithy and prays to Erebos.
timeline.quote: She said a quick prayer to Erebos , god of the dead, and hurried out of the forge.

citation.text: "Maia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
